properties.description:
- Deferred, low-priority MVP improvement; keep separate agent and human review tasks for the current migration.
- Allow one review to require several reviewers, with explicit ordering such as human review only after agent approval.
- Support collecting both reviewers’ feedback before the next correction round; keep individual outcomes and evidence visible.
- Agree the small workflow with the user before implementation; reject contradictory or cyclic ordering.
properties.title: Support multiple reviewers and review ordering in one task
